$doc.summary: Armies, corps, and the active combat preview for the Unit/Army screen.

fields.armies[].name: Display name e.g. 'Delta'.
fields.armies[].unit_ids: Ordered array of unit ids (from unit-data.json) that form this army.
fields.armies[].unlock_civic: Civic required to form armies (null = already unlocked).
fields.corps_slots: Max number of corps/armies the player can field.
fields.combat_preview: The current combat preview shown in the right panel.
fields.combat_preview.attacker: { unit_id, str, hp } — references unit-data.json id.
fields.combat_preview.defender: { name, str, hp } — may be an enemy unit (no id).
